statement.text:
Let G be a finite group, p a prime number, and let |xG | denote the maximum
                                                                 p
power of p that divides the class size of an element x ∈ G. Suppose that there exists
a p-element g ∈ G such that |g G |p = maxx∈G |xG |p . Is it true that G has a normal
p-complement?
    A partial answer is in (https://arxiv.org/abs/1812.03641).          I. B. Gorshkov
  ∗ No, not necessarily, a counterexample is given by SmallGroup(192,945) (B. Sam-
bale, Letter of 16 February 2022).
